primary.criterion: Three-seed TCN ensemble MSE lower than both history ridge and trees on the fixed evaluation trials.

limits: Saved sklearn tree estimator inference reused; no independent tree-engine implementation.
Selection minima checked against complete saved validation grids; candidate models not refitted.
Raw reconstruction covers every evaluation row and six separately checked fitting rows, not all training rows.
One successful-trial source subject/session; not continuous or unseen-condition evaluation.
